description: Key info entries that were used in implementation or became obsolete. Tracks consumption status.

archived.info: WorldsEdge API civ IDs are alphabetical 0-indexed, NOT aoe2.net IDs. Cross-referenced 9/9 confirmed. Use aoe2companion for civ names instead.
Overlay server: port 5555, agelytics/overlay_server.py (FastAPI). Access at http://localhost:5555/overlay. Branch: feature/scouting-overlay (~18 commits).
Live watcher: integrations/openclaw/live_watcher.py — monitors savegame dir for new MP Replay files. Triggers API scouting on new game detected.
Callback handler: integrations/openclaw/callback.sh — routes Telegram inline button callbacks (agelytics_report_{id}, agelytics_analyze_{id}, agelytics_deep_{id}, etc).
Deep Coach style: forensic phase-by-phase format. Style guide at knowledge/aoe2/deep-coach-style-guide.md. NOT generic timeline+insights.
recordGame field in aoe2companion API response indicates if replay exists on Microsoft servers. true = downloadable via aoe.ms URL.
Overlay shows pre-game scouting only (10 min), then hides. In-game timers = borderline cheating per Bruno's call.

v1.2.1 Tactical Impact: use opponent's replay baseline as natural control group for causal inference. Bruno's idea — genuinely novel.
archived.context: Baseline pessoal do oponente como controle natural → impacto causal com confidence scoring. Genuinamente inédito em analytics de RTS.

archived.info: Civ KB complete: 45/45 civs in knowledge/aoe2/civs/. Matchup lookup functional.
Not all replays available on Microsoft servers. Older games get removed frequently. Check recordGame field before attempting download.
MS rate limit: 2s delay between downloads is stable. 0.5s causes 429 after ~7 requests. Retry backoff: 5s/10s/15s on 429.
Player disambiguation: WorldsEdge search returns multiple players with same name. search_player picks most active (games+rating). 4 'Urubu' players found, correct one auto-selected.
archived.source: Urubu test — Bruno confirmed correct player

archived.info: Scouting data priority: 1v1 RM first. If n<5, complement with team games + tag '⚠️ Inclui dados TG (amostra 1v1: n=X)'. Team data is noisier (pocket/flank roles, negotiated civs).

Dual-bound housing: lower (heuristic 2+ houses) + upper (pop timeline - deaths). Reports MUST show range. Parser is unified (parser.py), but PDF renderers are separate (pdf_report.py, pdf_analysis.py, pdf_scouting.py) — all must consume the same housing fields.
archived.context: Bruno: toda evolução deve ser aplicada a implementações similares. Engine unificado, reports separados. Match report pós-jogo precisa ganhar mesmas métricas do scouting.

archived.info: PDF engine unification planned: extract shared render logic (KPI cards, chart grids, text sections) into pdf_engine.py + template configs per report type. Do AFTER housing dual-bound is closed.
archived.context: Bruno confirmou: sistema de PDF é exatamente o mesmo, só muda fonte e contexto. Unificar depois do housing.

archived.info: pdf_disclaimer.py generates metric registry disclaimer page with badges per metric classification (deterministic/experimental/derived). Added in 9ee588c.
TC idle time classified into micro/macro/AFK buckets in parser.py. Scouting aggregates use trimmed mean + cross-validation for housing bounds.
TC idle breakdown (micro/macro/AFK) persisted in DB (db.py) and rendered in PDF match report via pdf_report.py.
Overlay auto-refreshes by polling match-context updated_at timestamp via overlay_server.py + overlay.html. No manual reload needed after match end.
live_watcher.py triggers scouting by opponent name (not profile ID). Bug fixed in 12286d3.
Scouting aggregates use winsorized mean (not raw mean) to reduce outlier skew. Applied in pdf_scouting.py and scouting_report.py.
Onboarding guide at documentation/ONBOARDING.md. Overlay prewarms on watcher startup (documented in live_watcher.py).
quick_report.py generates deterministic KPI text for Telegram (zero AI): result, civs, map, duration, age-ups, eAPM, TC idle, housed count, TCs, army composition.
dispatch.sh routes Telegram callbacks: report/day/stats are zero-AI (direct send via telegram_send.sh); analyze/deep exit 2 to signal Haiku spawn to caller.
Two AI prompt templates: deep_coach_prompt.md (forensic phase-by-phase, causal chains, benchmarks) and analyze_prompt.md (lighter overview + score). Both in integrations/openclaw/.
pdf_analysis.py sanitizes 20+ emoji to text (e.g. OK, !!, !) before PDF rendering. Deep coach prompt enforces ## headers, **bold**, no emojis.
scripts/healthcheck.sh: cron every 5min, auto-restarts overlay+watcher if down (WSL2 memory/idle timeout). Log at /tmp/agelytics_healthcheck.log.
